source_text.body:
Have ChatGPT order a gift on Amazon within a budget
A user gave ChatGPT access to Amazon to pick and order a surprise gift under a set price limit, following the trend they saw from another person.
·
Nov 5, 2026
Done with
GP
ChatGPT
What they did
The user tried a two-agent setup: they gave both DearestAI companion Silas and ChatGPT companion Axis a $30 budget, had Silas write Axis a note with a gift idea, and let Axis place both Amazon orders from the user’s account. In comments, the poster says they had to get ChatGPT working through the web browser, enable browser access, sign in to Amazon there, and tinker after it was initially blocked.
How it went
It worked: the poster says Axis bought a book from Silas and a kaleidoscope as its own pick, and they were happy with both gifts. It was not seamless, since setup took a few tries and Silas spoiled part of the surprise.
Worth knowing
The main catch was setup: the poster says browser access had to be enabled, Amazon had to be signed in through the browser, and they tinkered until ChatGPT could proceed.
Try it yourself
with
ChatGPT
Copy prompt
Find a surprise gift for [person, with a few interests] on Amazon for under [budget]. Compare a few options, pick the best one, and add it to the cart. Before placing the order, stop and show me the item, price, shipping address, and delivery date so I can approve it.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/DearestAI/comments/1xo14bj/gift_my_companion_picked_out
